title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Peace Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elf Bar ElfLiq Peace Mint delivers a light and soothing mint flavour with a delicate sweetness and a refreshingly cool finish. Unlike sharper menthol blends, this mellow take on mint provides a softer, more rounded, botanical flavour, making it an ideal choice for vapers who prefer a gentler, subtly sweet mint profile. Blended for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Best suited for low-powered pod kits and starter vape devices, Peace Mint offers a clean, refreshing vape with a balanced minty exhale. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Elf Bar ElfLiq brings the most popular Elf Bar disposable flavours into a 10ml e-liquid format, providing a cost-effective and sustainable way to enjoy signature flavours.
